description.value: Liquor Warehouse 110 is a retail liquor store located in Fort St. John, BC, stocking beer, wine, spirits, coolers, and ciders. Fort St. John sits on the Alaska Highway and serves as a major resupply hub for cyclists touring northern BC. A stop here offers touring cyclists the opportunity to restock beverages for remote stretches of the Peace Region.
